## Services
- Panel & breaker box upgrades: Old, unsafe or undersized panels replaced with a safe, properly grounded panel, often finished in a day or two.
- AC wiring & disconnects: When the AC quits and the unit isn't the problem, we check the panel, upgrade the AC wiring and replace the disconnect.
- EV charger installation: Home EV charger installs with the breaker, wiring and charger connection explained in plain terms.
- Ceiling fans & fixtures: Ceiling fans, chandeliers and pendants hung, wired neatly and tested before we leave.
- Recessed & under-cabinet lighting: Brighter kitchens and living spaces with recessed cans and under-cabinet lights.
- Commercial panels & disconnects: Panel, meter and disconnect work in mechanical rooms and commercial spaces.

## About
Brian & Sons Co. is a family-run electrical company in Round Rock, working in homes across Round Rock and the nearby north Austin suburbs, with commercial panel and disconnect work too. Customers know our crew by name, Jonah and Bradley among them, and the same things come up in review after review: we call back quickly, even for small jobs like a single ceiling fan; we show up when we say we will; we explain the wiring in simple terms; and we leave the place neat. Most of all, we stick to the written quote. Check the work, write the price, do the job for that price. Customers tell us that is exactly what they paid, with no surprises.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Will the final bill match the quote?
  A: That's how we work. We check the electrical work first, give you a written quote, and stick to it. Customers tell us the quoted price was exactly what they paid.
- Q: My AC stopped working. Could it be electrical?
  A: Often, yes. If the AC unit itself checks out, the problem can be the wiring or the disconnect feeding it. We inspect the panel, the AC circuit and the disconnect, and fix what's wrong, often the same day.
- Q: Can you install my EV charger?
  A: Yes. We install home EV chargers, including the breaker and wiring, and explain the setup in plain terms. Call (512) 877-3921 with your charger model and where you park.
- Q: Do you take small jobs like one ceiling fan?
  A: Yes. A single ceiling fan or light fixture is a job we're happy to do, and we'll get back to you quickly with a fair quote.
- Q: My house has an old or second panel. Can you replace it?
  A: Yes. We replace old, unsafe service panels, including combining two older panels into one properly grounded panel, usually in a day or two.
- Q: What areas do you serve?
  A: We're based in Round Rock and work across Pflugerville, Hutto, Georgetown, Cedar Park and North Austin. Call to check your address.
